svg.title: Region map of the (a, b) form square
svg.desc: The unit square of the two form parameters. The curve b_n(a) = a / (2(1 - a)) for a up to 2/3 and the curve b_d(a) = 2(1 - a) / a for a from 2/3 to 1 meet at a = 2/3, b = 1. Below both curves the shape carries all three forms, d + n + h. Above b_n and left of a = 2/3 it is d + h; above b_d and right of a = 2/3 it is n + h. Seven markers show the preset habits.
svg.text: b = 0 — the d+n path: d → d+n → n
